target.title: fix(qa): simplify smoke lanes and isolate fanout
target.body:
Related: #101186
Related: #101187
Depends on: #102256

## What Problem This Solves

#101186 restored automatic QA Smoke coverage, but its implementation coupled a hardcoded three-row Actions matrix to a second dynamic shard planner, added speculative scenario weights, pinned a scenario count that immediately drifted, and consumed three Blacksmith runners per qualifying CI run.

It also left `subagent-fanout-synthesis` in a shared concurrent suite worker. That exact scenario failed twice on recent `main` runs while Matrix and the other Telegram shard passed:

- https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28935299128
- https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28947909491

The targeted scenario contracts from #101187 were correct and are already on `main`: Slack and WhatsApp restart/resume stay live-driver-only, and the silence-sensitive channel baseline stays isolated.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Replace the weighted three-shard planner with two explicit bounded lanes: Matrix and the current Crabline default channel.
- Keep the lane IDs stable if Crabline's default channel changes later.
- Fail closed if the smoke profile gains an unsupported third channel instead of silently adding runner fanout.
- Remove the hardcoded scenario total; profile growth is selected automatically.
- Isolate `subagent-fanout-synthesis`, which owns asynchronous child completion delivery and was failing inside a shared seven-scenario worker.
- Re-enable both QA Smoke jobs after the temporary kill switch in #102256.

This PR is intentionally stacked on #102256. After that PR merges, this branch can be rebased onto `main` without changing the reviewed patch.

## User Impact

Automatic QA Smoke returns with two Blacksmith shard jobs instead of three. The current profile resolves to 5 Matrix scenarios and 93 Crabline/Telegram scenarios. The aggregate required check remains fail-closed and artifact behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Recent #101186 runtime shape: Matrix completed in roughly 4-5 minutes; each 46/47-scenario Telegram shard completed in roughly 8-10 minutes, including duplicated package builds.
- Focused Testbox run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28960709690 — planner, catalog, suite-planning, and workflow guards passed, 104 tests total.
- Exact failing-batch replay on Testbox lease `tbx_01kx1apqv7ee0ybrjm9mxhn5k1`: 7/7 passed; logs show `subagent-fanout-synthesis` ran in a dedicated `scenarios=1 concurrency=1` worker.
- Fresh clean Testbox changed gate: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28961085005 — typecheck, lint, dependency guards, and import-cycle checks passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh autoreview: clean, no actionable findings, confidence 0.82.
- Production planner code shrinks from 114 lines to 74 lines; total patch is `+75/-140` across 7 files relative to #102256.
